title: Health, safety, environment and quality
metaDescription: Sato operates its own safety management system, implemented on every project and audited internally every three months.
statusNote: This page is not built and not linked. It is held here, rewritten from the company's own safety policy, until Sato and its oil and gas collaborator have reviewed it. Restoring it means adding app/hse/page.tsx back, putting HSE into site.json nav and footer, and removing the /hse redirect in vercel.json.

body: Safe sites and quality work are how we have kept clients for nearly three decades. Our HSE and quality management applies to every project, in every service.

sections.heading: Policy statement
body: Sato Engineering & Infrastructure Limited is committed to managing safety, quality and environmental matters across our operations in a professional manner. Our employees are our most valuable asset, and our first aim is to prevent them from sustaining work-related injuries.

sections.heading: Safety management system
body: Sato operates its own safety management system. It sets out corporate safety standards, safety management plans and implementation guidelines. The system is implemented on every project and audited internally every three months.

sections.heading: Training and induction
body: All employees attend monthly safety inductions, covering both general safety procedures and the procedures specific to the project they are working on.

sections.heading: Personal protective equipment
body: Personal protective equipment is provided to every employee as the work requires. The minimum standard on any Sato site is a safety helmet and safety boots.

sections.heading: Assessing us for a tender?
sections.body: We can provide our safety management system documentation, training records and project HSE history on request.
